propositions: rebar's LLM runtime branches on provider name strings to select behavior (retrying transport, prompt caching, output mode, structured settings), causing Anthropic-specific logic to leak into provider-agnostic code and leaving Bedrock support missing entirely

Bedrock clients need native support via BedrockProvider and BedrockConverseModel rather than an OpenAI-compatible gateway in order to preserve prompt caching, tenacity retry envelope, per-request timeout, native structured output, and accurate model provenance in signed sidecars

pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook and ModelProfile capability override mechanism enable a provider registry (providers.py) and per-vendor builder modules that decouple provider selection from behavior branching and eliminate string-match conditionals

Two support tiers (first-class Anthropic+Bedrock with native builders and full fidelity; best-effort everything-else via OpenAI-compatible) require structured provenance in sidecars so consumers can distinguish high-confidence verdicts from advisory ones

REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL and REBAR_LLM_API_KEY must compose with REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER to enable custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints, reversing the current _pai_check_config rejection and fixing documentation that already claims they work

Bedrock's retry/timeout configuration is botocore-resident (BedrockProvider + botocore.config.Config), not httpx-resident, so the first-class guarantee for Bedrock is capability parity (native builders, ModelProfile-driven output mode, prompt caching) rather than identical transport objects on both providers
